description: NEET PAGE PRO is designed to make NEET preparation simple, organized, and effective with NCERT-based resources, chapter-wise practice, important topics, and previous-year questions for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

KimiaXplore is an interactive chemistry learning application built with Flutter that helps users explore various chemistry topics through learning materials, flashcards, exercises, assessments, and simulations, with AI features to support a more flexible and personalized learning experience.

This website helps A-Level GCE science students practice and understand scientific experiments. It includes step-by-step practicals, explanations, diagrams, and tips for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. The goal is to make practical work easier to understand and help students succeed in exams.
JAMBPrep — Interactive JAMB/UTME practice platform for Nigerian students. Practice Mathematics, English, Physics & Chemistry with mock questions.

Practice the complete Practical Chemistry MCQ set for NEET, including easy, medium, and hard questions. Revise important laboratory concepts like qualitative salt analysis, titration principles, detection of elements in organic compounds, and common experimental techniques to improve accuracy and application-based understanding.

Master Surface Chemistry with a full NEET MCQ set covering adsorption, catalysis, colloids, emulsions, and key NCERT-based concepts—ideal for revision, accuracy building, and exam readiness with TopAll practice.

📚 Handwritten Chemistry Notes in PDF format for B.Sc. & M.Sc. students. Covers Inorganic, Organic, Physical, Analytical & Spectroscopic Chemistry, with concepts, reactions, mechanisms, formulas, derivations, and exam-oriented revision material.
